question.prompt: A data set has a maximum value of 98 and a minimum value of 41. Using a class width of 10, what is the minimum number of classes needed to include all the data?

solutions.explanation: \((98-41)\div10=5.7\), which is not an integer, so it must be rounded up. Thus, 6 classes are needed.
solutions.title: Use the data span and class width
